notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Plates carry either blue strips on both sides or a single red strip on the left; red on the left is found nowhere else in Europe.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: White bollards with a black top holding a red and grey reflector.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Pole tops shaped like an upside-down triangle are a good hint; simpler tops often show horizontal bars.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: If torn between this country and its neighbour to the northwest on bar-topped poles, pick this one.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Chevrons are white on a black background.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: The backs of road signs are often painted black.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: The S on stop signs has short ends at the same angle as the middle stroke, not vertical.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Numbers on speed limit signs use a bold font; the neighbour to the northwest has a much thinner one.

notes.subject: guardrail
notes.text: Flat, wide guardrail endings that curve away from the road are common.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: This language looks unlike its European neighbours; words often contain Ë and sometimes Ç. The word for street is rruga.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Mountainous and Mediterranean, with green slopes, bare rock patches and lots of exposed red soil by the road.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Cylindrical water tanks sit on many rooftops.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Italian-style buildings: pastel colours, orange tiled roofs and blocky shapes with many balconies.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Mercedes is by far the most common car brand, especially one particular sedan style.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Generation 4 coverage was shot with a low-mounted smallcam with a big round blur; rifts show up rarely in generation 3.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Low flat farmland and gentle hills lie mostly in the west around Shkodër, the capital and Vlorë; the Korçë plateau in the southeast is also flat.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The highest, almost alpine mountains are in the far north and far south.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Near the Greek border on the SH4 between Levan and Tepelenë, double outer edge lines with a wide gap can appear.

notes.subject: guardrail
notes.text: The A1 divided highway between Fushë Milot and Thumanë is the only one with a triple guardrail.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The SH4 near Vlorë shows a large bay with a long peninsula to the south and a small island to its north.
